campaign.title: Exploit period-four character cancellation in the dephased upper endpoint

conductor_policy.monitoring: Work only with the physical symmetric-profile limit. Freeze one scale and one h before Abel summation in q; retain the top jump, product cutoff, stars, floors, and physical X^(1/4) normalization.
conductor_policy.round_close: Close after a blind exact rederivation, an analytic BV proof, a hostile endpoint audit, and graph adjudication.

resource_policy.literature_policy: No source import is needed for the elementary period-four Abel mechanism; search only if the exact discrete-BV step fails.

frozen_target.sum: S_end(X)=sum_j sum_(1<=h<=H_j) Phi(h/(H_j+1))h^(-3/4) sum_q chi_4(q)q^(-3/4)[w_j(2sqrt(Xh/q))]^*, with the automatic hq<=N_X support and physical top convention.
frozen_target.candidate_bound: For Q_j(h)=Xh/D_j^2, prove the inner q-sum is O(Q_j(h)^(-3/4)) by bounded partial sums of chi_4 and uniform sampled BV. Then sum h and the geometric D_j scales to obtain S_end(X)=O(1).
frozen_target.success: A uniform normalized O(log^C X), preferably O(1), upper-endpoint bound with a complete top/product/star/floor audit, or an exact counterexample to the q-BV transfer.

campaign.promotion_policy: Promote only after independent agreement on q support, BV variation, the automatic product cutoff, the hard top jump, and the external X^(1/4) factor.
